title: Benefit Debts and Overpayment Recovery — Running Awards, Release of Liability and School Liability
content:
**Running awards and the method of collection.** Holding a running benefit award changes how a debt in **Benefit Debts and Overpayment Recovery** is collected. A debtor with a running Disability Compensation, Veterans Pension or education award listed among the debt type's offset benefit lines is collected by offset from that award. A debtor with no running award is billed for direct payment, and moves toward Treasury referral if the debt goes unpaid.

**Release of liability.** A Home Loan Guaranty Debt is never established against a veteran whose loan was assumed with a release of liability, because a release of liability bars a guaranty debt for that type.

**Student or school.** A Post-9/11 GI Bill Tuition and Fees Overpayment created by the student's own reduction or withdrawal is the student's debt, while one created by a school's certification error is established against the school and never against the student.

| Situation | Result |
|---|---|
| Running award on an offset benefit line | Collected by offset from that award |
| No running award | Billed for direct payment; moves toward Treasury referral if unpaid |
| Assumed home loan with a release of liability | No Home Loan Guaranty Debt against the veteran |
| Tuition and fees overpayment from the student's own reduction or withdrawal | The student's debt |
| Tuition and fees overpayment from a school's certification error | Against the school, never the student |
